qwen_contract_from_fresh_handoff.owner_prompt_validation: explicit owner prompt must be a non-empty string after trim check, but valid prompt bytes are returned unchanged

observed_gap: Notion resolve_prompt_policy rejects non-string or exactly empty owner_system_prompt, but accepts whitespace-only strings because it tests `not owner_prompt` rather than `not owner_prompt.strip()`.
risk: The same owner-mode request can be rejected by Qwen but accepted by Notion with effectively no application authority. This violates the shared two-mode owner contract and can create inconsistent delegation/failover semantics between providers.
minimal_fix: In Notion resolve_prompt_policy validate `not isinstance(owner_prompt, str) or not owner_prompt.strip()`.
After validation return the original owner_prompt unchanged; do not strip or normalize valid owner text.
Add tests for spaces-only and newline/tab-only rejection plus exact preservation of valid surrounding whitespace.
limits: No hosted CI, provider traffic, Windows, production, real user data or secrets used.
